family.description: This domain can be found at the N terminus of FHA domain-containing protein Fha from Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The FHA (Fork Head Associated) domain is a phosphopeptide- specific binding domain that enables the protein to specifically bind to sequences containing phosphothreonine. FhaA is one of the major substrates of Ser/Thr protein kinases (STPK) [[cite:PUB00059641]] and plays a role in the regulation of cell growth and peptidoglycan synthesis by binding to MviN. It may inhibit the late stages of peptidoglycan synthesis [[cite:PUB00057590]].
family.name: FhaA, N-terminal domain
